title: A local quadratic correction cannot supply the universal positive allocation bridge
statement: For scalar-Hessian jet h=(psi_xxx,psi_xxy,psi_xyy,psi_yyy),no symmetric quadratic3 by3 covariance map L(h) can be PSD with L02=L11 for EVERY h while matching all plane waves L(xi^3)=|xi|^2 r(xi)r(xi)^T,r=(x^2,xy,y^2). Symbol/PSD constraints uniquely force diagonal quadratic matrices diag(1,1,0,0),diag(0,1,1,0),diag(0,0,1,1). At h=(0,1,0,0),the required principal block[[1,1],[1,0]] has determinant-1. Restricting full vector jets reduces to this contradiction. The proof also excludes continuous current-value dependence under preserved covariance for every mean/smooth perturbation via linearization. It does NOT exclude nonlocal,field-dependent otherwise nonlinear/global operations,ordinary capacity itself or the existing heat QC theorem.
